تغتنمون (form VIII)
# تَغْتَنِمُونَ (taḡtanimūna) /taɣ.ta.ni.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# تُغْتَنَمُونَ (tuḡtanamūna) /tuɣ.ta.na.muː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
